usedFor: Shopify holds your store orders, and TemplateDocs builds a document from your template through “Generate Document from Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Generate Document from Template” in TemplateDocs
bestTemplate.why: A paid order produces a ready document, such as an invoice or packing note, from your template.

watchOut: “Order Line Items Are Edited” is a separate trigger, so an edited order will not regenerate this document.
